connector.name: Local Memory
connector.registryDescription: Persistent local AI memory. SQLite + FTS5 + vector search, knowledge graph. No cloud, no API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package local-memory-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the studiomeyer-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MEMORY_DB_PATH
env.description: Custom path for the SQLite database file

env.name: MEMORY_EMBED_DISABLED
env.description: Disable the local embedding pipeline (forces FTS5-only search). Useful in restricted networks where the model can't be downloaded.

env.name: MEMORY_EMBED_MODEL
env.description: Override the embedding model id (defaults to Xenova/multilingual-e5-small).

env.name: MEMORY_EMBED_CACHE_DIR
env.description: Override the Transformers.js cache directory (defaults to the OS data dir).
